validity.researcher_notes: P2575 (Empire Pipeline, NY to Ontario segment, 2.1 mi) and P6008 (PA to NY segment, 101 mi) are two scopes of the same Northern Access 2016 project (FERC docket CP15-115). P2575 is a small interconnect segment. Cancellation confirmed by National Fuel withdrawal announcement (WKBW 2024-11-07) and EIA status change to 'Cancelled' in Jul 2025. All three specs (2.1 mi, 24 in, 350 MMcf/d) confirmed against EIA Oct 2025 release. Status correctly recorded as 'cancelled'.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Recorded status 'cancelled' is correct and up-to-date. Cancellation confirmed by National Fuel public withdrawal statement (Nov 7, 2024) and reflected in EIA status changes (transitioned from 'Approved/On Hold' to 'Cancelled' between Apr 2025 and Jul 2025 releases). No revival or re-scoping identified. This small 2.1-mile NY-to-Ontario interconnect segment was part of the larger Northern Access 2016 project, which faced litigation, cost overruns, and state opposition. Project has not advanced in 7+ years since FERC certificate (2017); cancellation reflects permanent withdrawal
